newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia 1997 budget deficit seen at SKK 25 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia 1997 budget deficit seen at SKK 25 bln.

text.p: Slovakia's state budget is planned to total around 25 billion crowns in 1997, compared with the planned 1996 deficit of 27 billion crowns, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.

"According to the basic principles for creating the next year's state budget, budget revenues are expected to total around 175 billion crowns," said a ministry document, presented to the government at its regular Tuesday session.
Expenditures should be around 200 billion crowns, the document added..
In the first half of this year the state budget showed a deficit of 6.2 billion crowns, Finance Minister Sergei Kozlik said earlier.
